In-StudioTraining

A private studio, a dedicated trainer and a program written for you. No waiting for equipment, no one watching, nothing to figure out on your own.

Book a free consultation →
Format
1-on-1, or Partner Training with a friend or spouse
Session length
30, 45 or 60 minutes
Where
Hyde Park (SoHo) or Westshore
  1. 01

    It starts with an assessment

    Your first visit is a consultation and fitness assessment. Your trainer learns where you are strong, where you need work, how you eat and how you train now. Then they write a program specific to you.

  2. 02

    Then we get to work

    Sessions combine cardio, strength and core. Your trainer watches every rep and adjusts the difficulty as you progress, with homework to keep you on track between sessions.

  3. 03

    And we measure it

    Regular InBody scans measure fat, muscle, bone and water by body segment, with results sent to an app on your phone. You see progress in real data, not guesses.
